name: Iron Rivet
summary: Iron Rivet shipments from Stormwind now lie in gnoll camps north of Lake Everstill. Foreman Oslow needs them to mend Lakeshire's damaged bridge.

sections.title: Stolen Caravan Cargo
sections.body: Lakeshire's iron stores went into weapons and armor when Blackrock orcs attacked. After the assaults eased, Foreman Oslow asked Stormwind for supplies to mend the damaged Everstill Bridge. Redridge gnolls ambushed the caravan before it reached town. They dragged its wagons and pack beasts into the hills north of Lake Everstill, scattering iron rivets and pikes among their camps.

sections.title: Mending the Bridge
sections.body: The Everstill Bridge needs heavy iron rivets to hold its stone and timber framework together under the weight of carts and travelers. Foreman Oslow cannot safely carry out repairs without them. The bridge links Lakeshire to the western valleys, and its repair will help secure the town's perimeter against further incursions.

faq.q: What are Iron Rivets used for?
faq.answer: Foreman Oslow needs the iron rivets to repair the damaged Everstill Bridge in Lakeshire. Its original iron was melted down during the fighting with the Blackrock orcs.

faq.q: Why do the gnolls have these rivets?
faq.answer: Redridge gnolls ambushed a supply caravan from Stormwind and took its construction cargo. The rivets and iron pikes are now in their camps north of Lakeshire.

faq.q: Why was Lakeshire short on iron to begin with?
faq.answer: Lakeshire's defenders melted down the town's stored iron to make swords, bullets, and armor during the orc invasion.

faq.q: Who is looking for these rivets?
faq.answer: Foreman Oslow, who oversees the Everstill Bridge's restoration, is looking for the rivets.

angles.text: These heavy fasteners were forged in Stormwind for major building work, including stone and timber bridges.
Recovering the stolen supplies helps Lakeshire repair its infrastructure and curb the gnoll threat to the town.
